en: Oh! You've come at just the right time. // I only just opened the "Appraisal Hut," you see. // As you well know, the "Vandels" appeared without warning and ravaged this world. // We now live in the "Dark Century," with no telling when it will end... // The "Vandel Busters" arose to put an end to this plight... // They are said to have begun as bounty hunters working all over the world... // Busters use their combat skills to defeat Vandels and monsters wherever they may be, earning bounties to make their living... // The enormous bounties on Vandels attract many confident fighters hoping to make a fortune... // But many of them lose their lives. It is a very dangerous profession indeed, my boy...

The Buster Association exists to support these Busters in their work... // The Kingdom of Gransista established the Buster Association to bring the "Dark Century" to an end... // To support Busters in their work, the Association has set up "Appraisal Huts" throughout the land... // An "Appraisal Hut" is a vital place for any Buster, my boy. // First, accept a job here. Then complete it, and be sure to report back when you are done. // After a retinal appraisal, you will receive the bounty and Rank Points appropriate to that job... // A Buster must visit the "Appraisal Hut" often and never neglect to gather information...

Oh! You've repaired the Sealing Ring and returned safe and sound, eh? // Quite a fine job for your first assignment. // But don't think every job will be this easy. There is still plenty of work for a Buster to do. // Now, straight on to your next assignment... // Or so I'd like to say, but this is as far as you can play here at Jump Game World. // You'll have to wait until the game is released to discover what happens next. // Our time together was short, but thank you very much for spending your precious time playing. // Bouken-ou Beet: Vandel vs. Busters, exclusively for Nintendo DS, is scheduled for release in November 2005. // Do give it a try when it comes out, won't you? Fierce battles with truly formidable Vandels will await you then!
